units: per-panel: req/s for outcome rates, seconds for latency, bytes for L1
resolved_rate_interval: 1m (4 x configured 5s scrape interval minimum exceeded)

panels.query: sum(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result="hit"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result="miss"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result="stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

clamp(1 - (sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)), 0, 1)
sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))
min by (instance) (up{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id) (max by (run_id) (up{job=~"skipper-local|mock-origin"}) == 1))
min by (instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} and on (run_id) (max by (run_id) (up{job=~"skipper-local|mock-origin"}) == 1))
sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (instance, route, code) (rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, route, le) (rate(skipper_serve_route_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)))

100 * ((sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key=~"cache\\.(hit)"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))) or on (instance) (0 * sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key=~"cache\\.(hit|miss|stale)"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)))) / (sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key=~"cache\\.(hit|miss|stale)"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)
sum by (instance, key) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key=~"cache\\.(hit|miss|stale)"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (instance, result, code_class) (rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result=~"hit|miss"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (instance, result, code_class) (rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",result=~"l1_hit|l2_hit"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (origin) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))
sum by (origin, status) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))

clamp(1 - (sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)), 0, 1)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (origin, status, le) (rate(mock_origin_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)))
sum by (instance, key) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key=~"cache\\.(reval_error|reval_dropped)"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (instance, le) (rate(skipper_custom_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key="cache.reval_duration"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)))
max by (instance) (process_resident_memory_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_custom_gauges{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key="cache.lru_bytes"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

sum by (family, result) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_route_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*"))

sum by (family, outcome) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_route_reval_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*"))

panels.panel: Origin latency p95 by route family
panels.query: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (family, status_class, le) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_origin_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*")))

sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)
sum by (dispatch) (rate(skipper_cache_origin_duration_seconds_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",dispatch=~"direct|pipeline"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (cache_control) (rate(skipper_cache_origin_cache_control_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_entries{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_capacity_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+",key="cache.lru_eviction"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_first_hit_seconds{job="skipper-local",instance=~".+"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
min by (instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} and on (run_id) (max by (run_id) (up{job=~"skipper-local|mock-origin"}) == 1))
sum by (origin) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin",origin=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))

panels.panel: Origin responses by origin and status
panels.query: sum by (origin, status) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin",origin=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (origin, status, le) (rate(mock_origin_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="mock-origin",origin=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)))

sum by (origin, status) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin",origin=~".+",status!~"2..|304"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) or on (origin) (0 * sum by (origin) (rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin",origin=~".+"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)))
sum by (family) (label_replace(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",route=~"(.+)__(.+)"}[1m]) and on (instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "^(.+)__.+$"))
sum by (locale) (label_replace(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",route=~"(.+)__(.+)"}[1m]) and on (instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "locale", "$1", "route", "^.+__(.+)$"))

sum by (family, code) (label_replace(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",route=~"(.+)__(.+)",code!~"2.."}[1m]) and on (instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "^(.+)__.+$")) or on (family) (0 * sum by (family) (label_replace(rate(skipper_serve_route_count{job="skipper-local",route=~"(.+)__(.+)"}[1m]) and on (instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "^(.+)__.+$")))
